data.name: Status.Ready.Body
data.value: The printer is ready to print.

data.name: Status.Paused.Body
data.value: The printer is paused. Choose Resume to continue printing.

data.name: Status.HeadOpen.Body
data.value: The print head is open. Close the cover until it clicks, then choose Retry.

data.name: Status.MediaOut.Body
data.value: Printer reported media out. Load labels and close the cover, then choose Retry.

data.name: Status.RibbonOut.Body
data.value: The ribbon has run out or is not loaded. Load a 74 m ribbon roll and close the cover, then choose Retry.

data.name: Status.OverTemperature.Body
data.value: The print head is over temperature and printing has stopped. Let it cool for a few minutes; printing resumes on its own.

data.name: Status.UnderTemperature.Body
data.value: The print head is below operating temperature. Move the printer somewhere warmer than 5 °C.

data.name: Status.Connecting.Body
data.value: Reading the printer's configuration and checking which settings it supports.

data.name: Status.Claimed.Title
data.value: Printer is in use by another program

data.name: Status.Claimed.Body
data.value: Windows found the printer, but another program is holding it. Close ZebraDesigner or Zebra Setup Utilities, then choose Reconnect.

data.name: Status.Unplugged.Body
data.value: The printer was disconnected from USB. Plug the cable back in and it will reconnect automatically.

data.name: Status.NotFound.Body
data.value: The printer is no longer on USB. Check the cable and power, then choose Reconnect.

data.name: Status.NotResponding.Body
data.value: The printer stopped answering. Check that it is switched on and the USB cable is secure, then choose Reconnect.

data.name: Status.ChoosePrinter.Body
data.value: More than one printer is connected. Select the one to use.

data.name: Status.NoPrinter.Body
data.value: No Zebra printer is connected over USB. Check the cable and power. On a new ZD220, remove the sticker covering the USB port.

data.name: Printers.CommandError
data.value: Couldn't complete that on the printer: {0}

data.name: Command.UnexpectedError
data.value: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the app.

data.name: Printers.Hint.NotConnected
data.value: Connect a printer to use these actions.

data.name: Printers.Hint.Fault
data.value: Clear the printer fault to print or feed.

data.name: Printers.Hint.Paused
data.value: Resume the printer to print a test label.

data.name: Printers.Hint.Calibrating
data.value: Calibrating — printing and feeding are paused until it finishes.

data.name: Settings.BackupFailed
data.value: Couldn't save a backup of the printer's settings, so nothing was changed. Check that there is free disk space, then try again.

data.name: Calibration.FeedNotice
data.value: Calibration feeds about {0} labels while the printer measures the media.

data.name: Calibration.NoChange
data.value: The printer measured the same label length as before, so nothing changed.

data.name: Calibration.Check.Media.Problem
data.value: No labels detected — load labels first

data.name: Calibration.Check.Cover.Problem
data.value: Cover is open — close it until it clicks

data.name: Calibration.Check.Ribbon.Problem
data.value: No ribbon detected — load a ribbon first

data.name: Calibration.Failed.NotConnected.Body
data.value: Connect the printer with its USB cable and switch it on, then try again.

data.name: Calibration.Failed.HeadOpen.Body
data.value: The cover was open, so calibration stopped. Close the cover until it clicks, then run SmartCal again.

data.name: Calibration.Failed.MediaOut.Body
data.value: The printer reported media out before calibrating. Load labels and close the cover, then run SmartCal again.

data.name: Calibration.Failed.RibbonOut.Body
data.value: The printer reported no ribbon. Load a ribbon, then run SmartCal again.

data.name: Calibration.Failed.NoGapFound.Title
data.value: The printer couldn't find the gap between labels

data.name: Calibration.Failed.NoGapFound.Body
data.value: It fed labels looking for a gap or mark and never found one. This usually means the media can't be sensed by this printer. Check media compatibility before trying again.

data.name: Calibration.Failed.Timeout.Body
data.value: The printer didn't report a result in time. Check that labels feed freely, then run SmartCal again. If it keeps happening, check media compatibility.

data.name: Checker.SizeQuestion
data.value: Is each label at least {0} in ({1} mm) long and {0} in wide?

data.name: Checker.Reason.GapOffCentre
data.value: The gap or notch isn't at the centre of the media. This printer's gap sensor is fixed at the centre and can't be moved.

data.name: Checker.Reason.MarkOnRight
data.value: The black mark is on the right side. This printer's mark sensor only reaches from the centre to the left edge.

data.name: Checker.Reason.BelowMinimumSize
data.value: The labels are smaller than this printer's minimum size, so it can't calibrate on them.

data.name: Checker.Compatible.Body
data.value: Its gap, mark and size suit this printer's sensors. Run SmartCal again with the media loaded straight and the cover closed.

data.name: Checker.Incompatible.Title
data.value: This media can't be calibrated on this printer

data.name: Checker.Incompatible.Body
data.value: Retrying won't help. Either change to media that suits the printer, or use continuous mode with a set label length.

data.name: MediaSetup.Rejected
data.value: The printer didn't accept: {0}. It kept its previous value.

data.name: MediaSetup.OutOfRange
data.value: That value is outside what this printer supports. Enter a value within the range shown.

data.name: MediaSetup.LengthOutOfRange
data.value: Enter a label length between {0} and {1}.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.SolidGreen.Meaning
data.value: The printer is ready for print and data activity.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.SolidGreen.Action
data.value: No action needed; the printer is ready to print.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.FlashingGreen.Meaning
data.value: Normal operation; the printer is communicating or processing data.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.FlashingGreen.Action
data.value: Wait for the light to turn solid green before sending another job.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.DoubleFlashingGreen.Pattern
data.value: Double-flashing green (two short flashes, one long flash)

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.DoubleFlashingGreen.Action
data.value: Choose Resume in the app to continue printing.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.FlashingRed.Meaning
data.value: The printer is open, out of media, unable to sense the loaded media, or detecting a cut error.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.FlashingRed.Action
data.value: Close the cover and check that media is loaded and sensed correctly, then choose Retry.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.FlashingAmber.Meaning
data.value: The print head is over temperature and must cool before printing resumes.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.FlashingAmber.Action
data.value: Let the printer cool; printing resumes on its own.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.FlashingRedRedGreen.Meaning
data.value: The print head or motor has failed.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.FlashingRedRedGreen.Action
data.value: Power the printer off and contact support; this fault isn't user-serviceable.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.HoldFeedOneFlash.Pattern
data.value: Hold FEED 2 s, release at the first flash

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.HoldFeedOneFlash.Meaning
data.value: Prints a configuration report and exits Advanced mode.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.HoldFeedOneFlash.Action
data.value: With the printer ready, hold FEED for 2 seconds and release as soon as the light flashes once.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.HoldFeedTwoFlashes.Pattern
data.value: Hold FEED, release at the second flash

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.HoldFeedTwoFlashes.Meaning
data.value: Runs Smart Cal to measure the loaded media and set its sensing parameters.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.HoldFeedTwoFlashes.Action
data.value: Keep holding FEED past the first flash and release at the second flash.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.HoldFeedThreeFlashes.Pattern
data.value: Hold FEED, release at the third flash

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.HoldFeedThreeFlashes.Meaning
data.value: Resets the printer to its factory default settings.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.HoldFeedThreeFlashes.Action
data.value: Keep holding FEED past the second flash and release at the third flash.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.ReleaseFeedAfterThirdFlash.Pattern
data.value: Hold FEED 2 s or more past the third flash

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.ReleaseFeedAfterThirdFlash.Meaning
data.value: Exits Advanced mode without making a change and returns to normal operation.

data.name: BlinkCode.ZD220.ReleaseFeedAfterThirdFlash.Action
data.value: Keep holding FEED for 2 or more seconds after the third flash, then release.
